# tfcensus rules

Ownership rules sort the resources no unit manages into categories such as aws-managed,
other-iac or derived. The built-in packs run first, then the rules under rules: in the config and
in --rules files. rules test shows which rule matches a sample resource without calling AWS.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus rules <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus rules test rules.yaml
tfcensus rules test rules.yaml --resource samples.json --format json
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [tfcensus rules test](/cli/rules/test) | Compile ownership rules and evaluate them against sample resources, offline |
